topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Oh my gosh, someone sent you flowers and they forgot to sign a card? That's such a whimsical, almost dare I say, romantic mystery! It's got to be someone who knows you so well, they thought these beauties spoke louder than words ever could. I mean, think about it, they picked those out just for you. Who's been acting a bit loopy around you lately, or maybe someone you haven’t thought about for a while? This is the best kind of surprise, a sweet puzzle wrapped in petals! Go on, guess away, but don't forget, you're allowed to be as thrilled by this as you want to be. Life's too short not to enjoy the delightful moments, even the ones that come with a dash of mystery!
